You get practice at being cheerful near someone who is not, and at being low without spoiling things. It makes you considerate. It also means you seldom celebrate at full volume.
composite_aspect.fortune_sextile_moon:
Small comforts, deliberately arranged, do you more good than big treats.

The Moon in sextile to the Part of Fortune says look after the ordinary things: decent bread, clean towels, bed at a sensible hour. Set these up on purpose and your moods even out and money goes further. It sounds too simple to bother with. That is why most couples with this aspect leave it lying idle and wonder why they are tired.
composite_aspect.fortune_square_moon:
What one of you needs in order to feel safe keeps colliding with what makes life pleasant.

A mother who must be visited every Sunday. A thermostat war. The Moon square the Part of Fortune sets habit and feeling against ease, so the comfortable choice upsets somebody and the soothing one costs the afternoon. These are old needs and they do not respond to logic. They respond, a little, to being asked about before the plan is made.
composite_aspect.fortune_trine_moon:
This is a household where people feel better for walking in.

Moods and comforts agree. With the Moon trine the Part of Fortune there is usually something in the fridge, a spare blanket and time to listen, and the two of you recover from bad days faster than most. You hardly think about it. Guests do, and tend to stay longer than they meant to.
composite_aspect.fortune_conjunction_neptune:
Good things arrive here by drift and happy accident.

You cannot explain how you found the flat, or why the stranger paid for dinner. Neptune with the Part of Fortune gives the pair a soft sort of luck that works best when nobody grips too hard: music, water, afternoons with no plan. It is lovely. It is also why nobody knows where the insurance papers are, or exactly how much is in the account.
composite_aspect.fortune_opposition_neptune:
Contentment with what is real pulls against longing for something finer.

The Part of Fortune has a decent flat and a paid bill. Neptune opposite is sure there is a better life, somewhere warmer, with more meaning in it. One of you is satisfied and the other is homesick for a place you have never lived. Brochures appear. The contented partner learns not to say what is wrong with here.
composite_aspect.fortune_sextile_neptune:
Daydreams can be turned into real comfort with a little structure.

Neptune in sextile to the Part of Fortune offers the cottage by the sea, the band, the painted room, but only as far as the two of you are willing to do the boring half. Open the savings pot. Book the lessons. The imagining is free and pleasant, and couples who stop there end up with a very nice list.
composite_aspect.fortune_square_neptune:
Wishful thinking keeps leaking money and peace of mind.

It will probably be fine. Someone said they would pay us back. Neptune square the Part of Fortune blurs the edges of what you own and owe, so comfort rests on guesses: the subscription nobody cancelled, the loan with no date on it. Each discovery brings the same quarrel about who was supposed to check. Usually it was both of you.
composite_aspect.fortune_trine_neptune:
Ease comes naturally when the two of you stop steering.

A walk with no destination ends at the right cafe. With Neptune trine the Part of Fortune you have a talent for pleasant accidents and for making a room feel gentle, and you rarely have to try. Money comes and goes without drama. A little vagueness about bills is the price, and so far somebody has always remembered in time.
composite_aspect.fortune_conjunction_north_node:
What comes easily to you is also where you are meant to be heading.

Most couples have to choose between the comfortable thing and the growing thing. With the Part of Fortune on the North Node they are the same road, so each step into unfamiliar territory is met with a bit of luck: a welcome, a cheap fare, a helpful stranger. The only way to waste it is to stay where you are out of habit.
composite_aspect.fortune_opposition_north_node:
Your luck lies in what you already know, and your future lies somewhere else.

The Part of Fortune opposite the North Node sits with the South Node, in old skills, old friends and the family way of doing things. All of that works and pays. All of it also keeps you where you were. One partner banks the easy win. The other asks what you are becoming, and gets no good answer on a comfortable evening.
composite_aspect.fortune_sextile_north_node:
Trying something new together is likelier than usual to be rewarded.

The Part of Fortune in sextile to the North Node puts a small prize on the unfamiliar. Take the class neither of you is good at, move to the town you do not know, say yes to the odd invitation. You have to choose it. Left to routine, life stays pleasant and you never learn what the other option held.
composite_aspect.fortune_square_north_node:
Being comfortable is what stops you growing.

A good sofa, a known pub, friends who never change. The Part of Fortune square the North Node makes ease into a fork in the road, and the two of you keep taking the soft turning. Then one of you gets restless and blames the other for the rut. It comes up at every birthday with a zero in it.
composite_aspect.fortune_trine_north_node:
You grow without having to suffer for it.

Change agrees with you. With the Part of Fortune trine the North Node, the new job or the new city tends to come with decent weather and somewhere nice to eat, so the pair of you move forward more readily than couples who associate growth with pain. Since it is this painless, you may not notice how far you have come until an old friend points it out.
composite_aspect.fortune_conjunction_pluto:
Comfort is something this couple holds on to tightly.

You have known what it is to have little, or you fear it, and Pluto on the Part of Fortune makes security a serious matter. Money is watched. The freezer is full. When things go well they go very well, because neither of you wastes a chance. The grip is the problem: who controls the account can matter more than what is in it.
composite_aspect.fortune_opposition_pluto:
Ease on one side meets intensity on the other.

A quiet life with a few nice things would suit the Part of Fortune. Pluto opposite wants to know what is underneath: whose money it really is, what happens if it all goes. So one partner relaxes and the other digs. The digger thinks the relaxed one is naive. The relaxed one would like to finish a meal without a conversation about wills.
composite_aspect.fortune_sextile_pluto:
Clearing out what you no longer need makes room for better fortune.

Pluto in sextile to the Part of Fortune rewards the deliberate purge: the debt paid down, the storage unit emptied, the draining friendship allowed to lapse. It is hard for a weekend and a relief for a year. You both know which cupboard, literal or otherwise, needs opening. This aspect only promises that it will be worth it.
composite_aspect.fortune_square_pluto:
Struggles over who holds the purse keep spoiling what you have.

There is enough. That is rarely the issue. Pluto square the Part of Fortune turns comfort into a question of power, so a new sofa becomes a contest and a gift arrives with conditions. One of you checks the statement in private. The other notices. Until spending is done in the open, good fortune buys you surprisingly little peace.
composite_aspect.fortune_trine_pluto:
You come back from setbacks richer than you went in.

Redundancy turns into a better job. A flood pays for the new kitchen. With Pluto trine the Part of Fortune the pair has deep reserves and a knack for finding the advantage in a bad turn, so trouble frightens you less than it does other people. You could be more generous to those without that knack.
composite_aspect.fortune_conjunction_saturn:
Good fortune here is earned slowly and kept.

No windfalls. Saturn on the Part of Fortune gives the couple the sort of comfort that comes from thirty years of paying things off, mending what breaks and owning one good coat. It is real and it lasts. In the early years it can feel like no luck at all, and the two of you are apt to forget to enjoy what you worked for once it finally arrives.
composite_aspect.fortune_opposition_saturn:
One of you says enjoy it and the other says save it.

On this side, the Part of Fortune and a table booked for Friday. On that side, Saturn with the calculator. Every pleasure has to get past a sober second opinion, and every economy is accused of meanness. Because you are both partly right, the budget ends up a decent one. It just takes more arguing than it should.
composite_aspect.fortune_sextile_saturn:
Patience and a plan will buy you more comfort than any stroke of luck.

Saturn in sextile to the Part of Fortune is the aspect of the standing order and the five year plan. Put a fixed sum away. Learn the trade properly. Nothing exciting happens and after a decade you own something. Couples who find all this too dull stay roughly where they started, pleasantly, and grumble about house prices.
composite_aspect.fortune_square_saturn:
Duty keeps standing between you and a good time.

There is always a reason not to: the overtime, the elderly parent, the roof. Saturn square the Part of Fortune rations pleasure, and one of you is usually the one holding the ration book. The other calls it joyless. Then the bill for the fun arrives and the careful one says I told you so. You have had this conversation in several kitchens.
composite_aspect.fortune_trine_saturn:
Stability is what this pair finds easy.

Bills are paid on time without anyone feeling virtuous about it. With Saturn trine the Part of Fortune you are comfortable with limits, good at maintenance and unbothered by waiting, so what you own tends to last and grow. Younger friends borrow your ladder and ask your advice about pensions. A little more frivolity would not hurt either of you.
composite_aspect.fortune_conjunction_sun:
Being fully yourselves is what brings this couple its luck.

The Part of Fortune sits with the Sun when a chart is cast at a new moon, and it gives a plain result. Whatever the two of you are openly proud of, the shop, the children, the garden, is also where ease and money come from. You do not have to hide or hedge. The failing is a certain self satisfaction, since what you like and what works have never been different things.
composite_aspect.fortune_opposition_sun:
You see your luck most clearly in each other.

This is the full moon pattern: the Part of Fortune opposite the Sun. What one of you sets out to do, the other makes comfortable, and each thinks the other got the better deal. The ambitious one envies the easy one's contentment. The contented one envies the purpose. It works well, provided somebody occasionally says so.
composite_aspect.fortune_sextile_sun:
Confidence would pay, if you showed a bit more of it.

With the Sun in sextile to the Part of Fortune, the pair does well whenever it steps forward and says this is ours, we made it. Enter the thing. Put your names on the door. You are inclined to be modest and let chances go to louder couples. Half an hour of nerve, a few times a year, changes the sum considerably.
composite_aspect.fortune_square_sun:
Pride and comfort keep tripping over each other.

The cheap option would do perfectly well and one of you will not be seen taking it. Or the easy path is open and it feels beneath you. The Sun square the Part of Fortune makes the couple pay extra for dignity, in money and in effort. You argue about whether that is self respect or showing off. It depends on the week.
composite_aspect.fortune_trine_sun:
What you are good at and what is good for you line up.

The Sun trine the Part of Fortune is a quiet blessing. The pair of you tend to be paid for the things you enjoy, liked for qualities you really have, and well in yourselves most of the time. It does not make you rich. It makes you hard to knock off course, and a little slow to understand couples who are always struggling.
composite_aspect.fortune_conjunction_uranus:
Your luck is sudden, odd and never arrives twice by the same door.

A win on a ticket bought by mistake. A job from a wrong number. Uranus on the Part of Fortune gives the pair breaks nobody could plan for and a comfortable disregard for how things are usually done. It also takes away without notice. You do well to keep a cushion and to enjoy each surprise for what it is.
composite_aspect.fortune_opposition_uranus:
Security pulls one way and freedom pulls the other.

Just as the Part of Fortune gets the place how it likes it, Uranus opposite starts reading about living on a boat. One partner counts what could be lost and the other counts the years. Neither of you wins outright, so life goes in bursts: three settled years, then a leap, then the slow business of getting comfortable again.
composite_aspect.fortune_sextile_uranus:
Doing one thing differently could change your fortunes.

Uranus in sextile to the Part of Fortune favors the experiment: work from another town for a month, sell the car, try the scheme your cautious friends laughed at. It will not all succeed. Enough does to make the habit worthwhile. The opening closes on couples who talk about change as a hobby and never alter a single arrangement.
composite_aspect.fortune_square_uranus:
Just when things settle, something upends them.

The landlord sells. The firm restructures. One of you gets bored and resigns. With Uranus square the Part of Fortune, comfort does not stay put, and half the disruptions are your own doing. Whoever wanted stability feels ambushed. Whoever wanted air feels caged. You are better at recovering than at preventing, which is something.
composite_aspect.fortune_trine_uranus:
Change tends to leave you better off.

Other couples dread the unexpected letter. You have mostly had good ones. Uranus trine the Part of Fortune makes the pair light on its feet, quick to see what a new situation offers and unsentimental about leaving the old one. Living with you is never dull. Now and then a quiet year would be a kindness to whoever does the packing.
composite_aspect.fortune_conjunction_venus:
Pleasure, affection and good fortune all come from the same place here.

Venus with the Part of Fortune makes the couple easy to like and easy to be generous to, and you return the favor with good food and a pretty house. Love feels lucky. There is no harm in it beyond a taste for nice things that runs slightly ahead of income, and a dislike of any conversation that might spoil the mood.
composite_aspect.fortune_opposition_venus:
One of you gives pleasure and the other receives the luck.

Venus opposite the Part of Fortune splits charm from benefit. The partner who does the hosting, the remembering of birthdays and the choosing of presents watches the other get the thanks, the contact and the lucky break. Reverse it and the same complaint appears. A fair marriage of this kind keeps rough accounts and says well done aloud.
composite_aspect.fortune_sextile_venus:
A little effort spent on pleasure comes back doubled.

Venus in sextile to the Part of Fortune says buy the flowers, book the table, wear the good shirt on a Tuesday. These are small acts and they have to be chosen, since neither of you will be forced into them. Do them and the whole household softens. Neglect them and nothing bad happens, which is exactly how the warmth quietly goes.
composite_aspect.fortune_square_venus:
What one of you likes and what is good for you both keep parting company.

A taste for shoes, wine or company that the budget does not share. Venus square the Part of Fortune sets desire against comfort in small, repeated ways, and the two of you take it personally: one feels stinted, the other feels used as a wallet. It is seldom a great sum. It is the same sum, argued over, every month.
composite_aspect.fortune_trine_venus:
Life together is simply pleasant, most of the time.

You like the same things and can generally afford them. With Venus trine the Part of Fortune there is affection in the house, something good in the oven, and friends who are glad to come round. Nobody had to work at this. The only risk is drifting into a comfort so complete that neither of you asks the other a searching question for years.
composite_aspect.spirit_conjunction_ascendant:
What this couple intends is written on its face.

Nobody has to guess what the two of you are about. With the Part of Spirit on the Ascendant, your aims walk into the room before you do: the campaign, the business, the plan to move abroad. That makes you persuasive and easy to recruit for. It also means you are seldom off duty, and friends who only wanted a drink get the full prospectus.
composite_aspect.spirit_opposition_ascendant:
Your sense of purpose keeps turning up in the people you meet.

Opposite the Ascendant the Part of Spirit sits with partners, clients and rivals, so what the two of you are meant to do tends to be shown to you by somebody else: a mentor's remark, a competitor's success. One of you finds that inspiring. The other feels directed from outside and digs in. Whose idea was it really? is asked a good deal in this house.
composite_aspect.spirit_sextile_ascendant:
Saying out loud what you are trying to do would bring help you are not getting.

People like the pair of you without quite knowing what you are for. The Part of Spirit in sextile to the Ascendant closes that gap whenever you bother to state the aim plainly, at a dinner, on a form, to the neighbor with the van. Help turns up once it has something to attach to. Keep it private and you stay well liked and unassisted.
composite_aspect.spirit_square_ascendant:
The way you come across keeps working against what you actually mean to do.

You intend to be taken seriously and arrive joking. Or you want a quiet life and somehow chair every meeting. The Part of Spirit squaring the Ascendant puts purpose and manner at odds, so others respond to the wrong signal and you both go home irritated. Which of you gave the false impression this time is a row you could hold in your sleep.
composite_aspect.spirit_trine_ascendant:
Manner and purpose fit, so people understand you at once.

There is no translating to do. With the Part of Spirit trine the Ascendant the couple looks like what it is trying to be, and the right allies recognize you early. Plans get a fair hearing. This comes so readily that you underrate it, and you can be puzzled by pairs who work twice as hard to be believed.
composite_aspect.spirit_conjunction_chiron:
What you set out to do grows straight out of what once went wrong.

The couple's purpose and its sore spot are in the same place. Chiron joined to the Part of Spirit means the project, whatever it is, exists because of an old hurt: the school that failed one of you, an illness, a parent's bankruptcy. That gives the work depth and stamina. It also means criticism of the plan lands on the wound, and you both overreact.
composite_aspect.spirit_opposition_chiron:
One of you is driving toward a goal and the other is nursing a hurt.

Onward, says the Part of Spirit. Chiron across from it says wait, something here still aches. So the purposeful partner feels held back and the sore one feels dragged. You swap roles more often than either admits. Progress comes in the weeks when the one with the plan slows down enough to ask what the matter is, and waits for the answer.
composite_aspect.spirit_sextile_chiron:
An old difficulty could be put to use, if you decide to use it.

Chiron in sextile to the Part of Spirit offers a trade. What each of you learned the hard way is worth something to other people, as teaching, as advice, as a service nobody else thought of. Turning it into that takes a conscious choice and a first awkward attempt. Left alone, the experience stays private and merely painful.
composite_aspect.spirit_square_chiron:
Ambition keeps stepping on the tender place.

Every time you push for something, one of you is reminded of not being good enough. Chiron square the Part of Spirit makes goals themselves the trigger: the application, the audition, the business plan. So you set an aim and then flinch from it, and the partner who did not flinch calls it self sabotage. It recurs with each new attempt until the fear is named before the form is filled in.
composite_aspect.spirit_trine_chiron:
You can aim high without reopening old wounds.

Past failures do not have much grip here. With Chiron trine the Part of Spirit the pair treats what went wrong as information, and each of you can be encouraged without being handled. Plans are made in a kind atmosphere. If anything you are too gentle with one another, and a blunt friend is useful when a project needs honest criticism.
composite_aspect.spirit_conjunction_jupiter:
Big intentions come naturally, and you believe in them completely.

With Jupiter on it, the Part of Spirit does not think small. A degree turns into a doctorate, a market stall into a chain, a holiday into a year away. Your confidence is infectious and often justified. Where it fails, it fails through promising more than two people can deliver, and through a reluctance to hear the word budget.
composite_aspect.spirit_opposition_jupiter:
A clear aim on one side meets a hundred possibilities on the other.

The Part of Spirit knows what the two of you decided. Jupiter opposite has since heard of something better. So one partner holds the line and the other keeps widening it: another country, another course, another cause. Focus accuses breadth of flightiness. Breadth accuses focus of having no imagination. You need both, in that order.
composite_aspect.spirit_sextile_jupiter:
Your aims would grow if you gave them a wider stage.

Jupiter in sextile to the Part of Spirit puts opportunity within reach of intention: a grant you qualify for, a teacher worth travelling to, a publisher who answers letters. You have to apply. The pair that sends the application generally gets more than it asked for. The pair that means to send it has an excellent plan in a drawer.
composite_aspect.spirit_square_jupiter:
What you mean to do keeps swelling beyond what you can manage.

It starts as a sensible goal. Then Jupiter gets hold of it. Squaring the Part of Spirit, it adds a second site, a bigger loan, a launch party, until the original purpose is buried under its own extensions. One of you sells the dream and the other counts the hours left in the week. You have rescued several projects by cutting them in half.
composite_aspect.spirit_trine_jupiter:
Good faith and good timing carry your plans forward.

You set out to do something and the world, broadly, agrees. Jupiter trine the Part of Spirit gives the couple optimism that is usually rewarded, generous backers and a reputation for meaning well. The work still has to be done. Because encouragement comes so freely, you are apt to start one scheme more than you finish.
composite_aspect.spirit_conjunction_mars:
Once this couple decides, it moves.

There is very little distance between intention and action here. Mars on the Part of Spirit means the call is made the same afternoon and the van is hired by evening. Things get done, including things other pairs only talk about. What you lack is a pause, and you have both learned that some decisions made at speed need unmaking at leisure.
composite_aspect.spirit_opposition_mars:
Purpose and appetite pull in different directions.

You both know what the plan is. And then there is what one of you feels like doing right now. Mars opposite the Part of Spirit sets desire against decision: the gym against the sofa, the savings against the motorbike. Whoever speaks for the plan sounds like a scold. Whoever speaks for the urge sounds like a child. Neither description is fair, and both get used.
composite_aspect.spirit_sextile_mars:
Your plans need a push, and the push is available.

Mars in sextile to the Part of Spirit supplies energy for whatever you have actually chosen to do, as distinct from what you vaguely hope. Set a date. Do the first hard hour. After that the momentum is real and the two of you work well side by side. Without the starting shove, good intentions sit in the hall like unpacked boxes.
composite_aspect.spirit_square_mars:
Temper keeps wrecking what you carefully set out to do.

You agreed the approach. Then one of you lost patience and did it the quick way. Mars square the Part of Spirit pits impulse against intention, and impulse is faster. The result is rework: the apology, the second coat of paint, the email recalled too late. Each blames the other's haste, or the other's dithering, depending on who jumped.
composite_aspect.spirit_trine_mars:
Wanting something and going after it are one smooth motion.

The pair decides and acts with no grinding of gears. With Mars trine the Part of Spirit you have courage in the right amount and at the right moment, and you rarely waste effort fighting each other over method. Deadlines are met. You are less good at stopping, and holidays tend to acquire a project by the third day.
composite_aspect.spirit_conjunction_mercury:
You think your way toward what you want, mostly out loud.

Lists, drafts, long walks spent arguing a point. Mercury joined to the Part of Spirit puts the couple's purpose into words, and nothing is real for you until it has been talked through and written down. You are good at explaining yourselves. The trap is mistaking a well phrased plan for a finished one, and discussing a thing for months that needed a morning.
composite_aspect.spirit_opposition_mercury:
One of you holds the purpose and the other holds the arguments.

Its mind made up, the Part of Spirit is finished with the subject. Mercury opposite wants to look at it from six more angles. So conviction meets cleverness, and each finds the other exhausting: one will not discuss, the other will not stop. Decisions improve when the talker is given a deadline and the decider agrees to listen until it arrives.
composite_aspect.spirit_sextile_mercury:
Writing the goal down would get you halfway there.

Mercury in sextile to the Part of Spirit favors the pair that puts intention into a sentence, then a list, then a calendar. It is a small discipline and it works out of all proportion. Conversations stop circling. Each of you knows what was agreed. Skip it, and you will have the same hopeful talk in the car next spring.
composite_aspect.spirit_square_mercury:
What you say you want and what you really intend do not match.

One of you agrees aloud and means something else. Or the plan is clear in your heads and comes out garbled to the bank, the builder or each other. Mercury square the Part of Spirit scrambles purpose in transmission. So you argue about wording when the real quarrel is about aims. It helps to ask, plainly, what are we actually trying to do?
composite_aspect.spirit_trine_mercury:
You explain what you are after, and people get it.

Words serve intention well here. With Mercury trine the Part of Spirit the couple can state an aim in two sentences, agree on it between yourselves without a scene, and put it to others without confusion. Forms get filled in correctly. It sounds minor. Ask any pair who cannot do it how much time they lose.
composite_aspect.spirit_conjunction_mc:
What you set out to do and what you are known for are the same thing.

The couple's intention is public. With the Part of Spirit on the Midheaven your aims become a career, a title or a cause with your names on it, and you would not know how to pursue them quietly. That brings recognition, and scrutiny with it. A change of mind, which any private pair is allowed, has to be announced like a change of government.
composite_aspect.spirit_opposition_mc:
Your real purpose is private, and the world wants you somewhere else.

Opposite the Midheaven, the Part of Spirit sits at the root of the chart: family, home ground, the life nobody applauds. That is what the two of you most deliberately care about. Careers keep demanding the hours. One partner guards the hearth as the true project. The other points out that hearths need paying for.
composite_aspect.spirit_sextile_mc:
Your aims could have standing in the world if you claimed it.

In sextile to the Midheaven, the Part of Spirit says the purpose is sound and the door is open, but nobody will usher you through. Register the company. Apply for the post. Put what you do on a card. Couples with this aspect who stay amateur do so by choice, and usually out of shyness they describe as principle.
composite_aspect.spirit_square_mc:
The work you are known for is not the work you meant to do.

A reputation got built, and it is for the wrong thing. The Part of Spirit squaring the Midheaven leaves the pair successful at something beside the point: the day job, the family firm, the role others handed you. Each promotion makes the real aim harder to reach. You argue about when to jump, and whether it is already too late, at roughly yearly intervals.
composite_aspect.spirit_trine_mc:
Ambition and reputation help each other along.

People in authority tend to back what you are trying to do. With the Part of Spirit trine the Midheaven, the couple's private purpose translates into public standing without contortion, and promotions arrive for the right reasons. You have never had to choose between meaning and career. Be patient with friends who have.
composite_aspect.spirit_conjunction_moon:
Feeling and intention are fused, for better and worse.

This pair cannot pursue something it does not feel. With the Moon on the Part of Spirit, plans rise and fall with mood, and a goal that stops feeling right is dropped however sensible it was. When heart and aim agree you are unstoppable and warm with it. On a low week the whole enterprise is in doubt by Wednesday.
composite_aspect.spirit_opposition_moon:
Head says go and heart says stay.

A direction is what the Part of Spirit has. The Moon opposite it has a home, a routine and people who would be missed. Usually one of you carries each side, so the forward one feels unsupported and the rooted one feels overruled. Moves, new jobs and babies bring it to a point. You do best by naming what would be lost before agreeing to go.
composite_aspect.spirit_sextile_moon:
Your plans go better when you check how each of you feels about them.

The Moon in sextile to the Part of Spirit asks for one extra step: before deciding, ask whether it sits well. Is anyone dreading this? What would make it bearable? It takes ten minutes. Aims chosen that way last, because nobody is quietly dragging their feet. Left out, the step gets taken later, as a mood nobody can explain.
composite_aspect.spirit_square_moon:
What you have decided to do keeps running into how one of you feels.

The plan is good. Somebody is homesick, tired or simply not ready. The Moon square the Part of Spirit sets need against intention, and need does not argue, it just stops cooperating. So the determined partner pushes and the other goes quiet. It happens at every big step. The plans that survive are the ones altered to fit an actual human being.
composite_aspect.spirit_trine_moon:
You want what is good for you, which is rarer than it sounds.

Habit and purpose run the same way. With the Moon trine the Part of Spirit the couple's daily comforts support its aims, so nobody has to be heroic: the work gets done between meals and a decent night's sleep. Your families tend to approve. You have never had much reason to test what you would give up for a goal.
composite_aspect.spirit_conjunction_neptune:
Your purpose is a vision more than a plan.

You know what it should feel like when you get there. The route is hazier. Neptune with the Part of Spirit gives the pair an aim that is artistic, charitable or devotional, and real faith in it. That faith moves other people. It also lets deadlines slide and makes you easy to fool, because anyone who speaks your language is assumed to share your intentions.
composite_aspect.spirit_opposition_neptune:
One of you has a goal and the other has a dream.

They sound alike and they are not. The Part of Spirit wants a date and a method. Neptune opposite wants it to be beautiful and would rather not be pinned down. So the planner feels undermined and the dreamer feels reduced to a timetable. You make good things when the dreamer chooses the destination and the planner books it.
composite_aspect.spirit_sextile_neptune:
Imagination can serve your aims if you give it a job.

Neptune in sextile to the Part of Spirit lends the couple a feel for what could be, and that is worth having when a plan has gone flat. Spend an evening picturing the finished thing in detail. Then write down three steps. The picture alone is a pleasant way to avoid starting, which is how most pairs use it.
composite_aspect.spirit_square_neptune:
You keep losing sight of what you set out to do.

There was a goal. Then came a distraction that looked like a higher calling, or a fog of doubt, or a charming person with a different idea. Neptune square the Part of Spirit dissolves intention quietly, and months later one of you asks what happened to the plan. The other thought it had changed. Nobody announced it. This is the quarrel, each time.
composite_aspect.spirit_trine_neptune:
Inspiration arrives when you need it.

Stuck on a problem, the two of you go for a swim and come back with the answer. With Neptune trine the Part of Spirit, purpose is fed by intuition and by a sense that the work means something, so you seldom grind. Others find your confidence slightly mysterious. Keep one practical friend who will ask where the money is coming from.
composite_aspect.spirit_conjunction_north_node:
What you decide to do and where you are meant to go are the same road.

This is a fortunate thing to have. With the Part of Spirit on the North Node the couple's deliberate choices keep landing on the growing edge, so effort is not wasted on detours. It feels like being on the right bus. The demand is that you keep choosing: the pull of the easy and familiar is still there, just behind you.
composite_aspect.spirit_opposition_north_node:
What you intend keeps leading you back to what you already know.

The Part of Spirit opposite the North Node stands on the South Node, so the couple's will is strongest in familiar territory. You are purposeful about the old trade, the old town, the way your families did it. Growth lies the other way and gets what is left of your energy. One of you notices and says so, usually in January.
composite_aspect.spirit_sextile_north_node:
A deliberate step would take you somewhere worth going.

The Part of Spirit in sextile to the North Node lines up intention with the direction of growth, loosely, like two roads that can be joined by a short lane. You have to walk the lane. Sign up for the unfamiliar thing on purpose. Couples who wait for it to happen to them stay capable and unchanged.
composite_aspect.spirit_square_north_node:
You are working hard at something that is not taking you anywhere new.

The effort is real and the aim is clear. It is just the wrong aim. The Part of Spirit square the North Node has the pair pouring intention into a side road while the main one waits. One of you senses it first and is accused of losing heart. The discussion returns, a little louder, each time a milestone is reached and feels hollow.
composite_aspect.spirit_trine_north_node:
Your choices tend to turn out to have been the right ones.

Looking back, the pair's decisions form a line. With the Part of Spirit trine the North Node, what you set out to do keeps serving where you needed to go, though you did not always know it then. That gives you a justified trust in your own judgment. Stay curious anyway. A good record is not a guarantee.
composite_aspect.spirit_conjunction_pluto:
When this couple wants something, it wants it completely.

Nothing is done by halves. Pluto on the Part of Spirit turns intention into something close to obsession: the business that eats weekends, the renovation down to the joists. You can outlast anyone. The cost is control. Each of you needs the project done your way, and the fiercest battles are fought over a shared aim nobody disputes.
composite_aspect.spirit_opposition_pluto:
One partner's purpose meets the other's need to control.

A proposal comes from the Part of Spirit. Pluto opposite it wants to know who is in charge, what it will cost and what is being hidden. So every plan is cross examined, and the one who made it feels distrusted. The examiner feels railroaded. When you get through it, what remains is very solid. Getting through it is the hard part.
composite_aspect.spirit_sextile_pluto:
Going deeper into what you want would make it far more effective.

Pluto in sextile to the Part of Spirit rewards the pair that asks why. Why this goal? What is it really for? An honest afternoon on that question strips out the aims you inherited and leaves one or two with force behind them. It is uncomfortable work and optional. Most couples prefer a longer list of weaker intentions.
composite_aspect.spirit_square_pluto:
Your plans keep turning into contests of will.

You agree on the aim and then fight over who decides. Pluto square the Part of Spirit makes purpose a matter of power, so compromise feels like surrender and a helpful suggestion sounds like a takeover. Projects stall while you both hold out. Outsiders cannot see what the fuss is about. It ends, for a while, when one of you is given clear charge of one thing.
composite_aspect.spirit_trine_pluto:
You have staying power that most couples only wish for.

Setbacks do not shake the aim. With Pluto trine the Part of Spirit the pair can concentrate for years, absorb a failure and come back with the plan improved. You do not need encouragement, which is lucky, because you seldom ask for it. Take care that persistence does not become an inability to drop something that has stopped being worth it.
composite_aspect.spirit_conjunction_saturn:
You take your aims seriously and pursue them the long way.

Saturn on the Part of Spirit makes a patient, dutiful sort of ambition. The couple sets one goal, a paid off house, a qualification, a business that lasts, and works at it for decades without fuss. You are respected for it. Joy is the thing in short supply. Reaching a milestone, you are likely to nod and ask what is next.
composite_aspect.spirit_opposition_saturn:
One of you wants to do it and the other can see why it will not work.

First the Part of Spirit states the aim. Saturn across the chart lists the difficulties, correctly. So one partner is cast as the dreamer and the other as the wet blanket, and both dislike the part. Used well, it is a proper test: what survives the objections is worth doing. Used badly, nothing is ever tried.
composite_aspect.spirit_sextile_saturn:
A timetable would turn your intentions into facts.

Saturn in sextile to the Part of Spirit offers structure to any aim you are willing to schedule. Break it into terms, quarters, Tuesdays. Hold each other to it without nagging. The reward is dull and large: finished things. Pairs who resist this as unromantic keep their freedom and a shelf of half learned languages.
composite_aspect.spirit_square_saturn:
Every time you decide on something, an obstacle appears.

No money, no time, a rule, a relative who needs you. Saturn square the Part of Spirit meets intention with delay, and the pair can come to believe that wanting things is pointless. One of you turns gloomy and the other turns stubborn. The aims that do get through are tougher for it. That is small comfort in the third year of waiting.
composite_aspect.spirit_trine_saturn:
Discipline comes without strain, so plans get finished.

You say you will do a thing and then you do it. With Saturn trine the Part of Spirit the couple is realistic about time and steady about effort, and neither of you needs supervising. Older people trust you with responsibility early. Younger ones find you a touch severe. Both judgments are accurate.
composite_aspect.spirit_conjunction_sun:
Who you are and what you are trying to do cannot be told apart.

The couple's identity is its purpose. With the Sun on the Part of Spirit you are the people who run the shop, raise the family, make the films, and you do it with evident pride. There is great energy in that. There is also no spare self to fall back on, so a setback to the plan is taken as a judgment on you both.
composite_aspect.spirit_opposition_sun:
What you are and what you are aiming at face each other across the chart.

At a full moon the Part of Spirit stands opposite the Sun, and so it does here. The pair's sense of itself is on one side and its intention on the other, usually carried by different partners. One says this is who we are. The other says this is what we should become. Hold both and you have a marriage that keeps moving.
composite_aspect.spirit_sextile_sun:
Putting more of yourselves into your aims would make them succeed.

The Sun in sextile to the Part of Spirit says the goal is fine and a little bloodless. Sign your work. Do it your way instead of the approved way. When the pair lets its own character show in what it sets out to do, people respond and the thing takes off. Otherwise you carry out worthy plans that could have been anybody's.
composite_aspect.spirit_square_sun:
Pride and purpose keep quarrelling.

What you intend to do would require one of you to look foolish, start at the bottom or take instruction. The Sun square the Part of Spirit puts ego in the path of the aim, so the pair wants the result and will not pay the entrance fee. You notice it in each other first. The apprentice year you both refused would be over by now.
composite_aspect.spirit_trine_sun:
You do what you mean to do, and it suits you.

Confidence and intention are on good terms. With the Sun trine the Part of Spirit the couple's aims are an honest expression of who you are, so nobody is acting and the work carries conviction. You enjoy yourselves. Praise comes fairly often, and you should accept it with better grace than you sometimes manage.
composite_aspect.spirit_conjunction_uranus:
Your aims are unusual and you change them without warning.

Nobody else has quite your plan. Uranus on the Part of Spirit gives the couple original intentions, a tiny house, a commune of two, a job that did not exist last year, and a habit of tearing them up overnight. It keeps you awake and interesting. It is hard on anyone depending on you, including each other, when the plan changes at breakfast.
composite_aspect.spirit_opposition_uranus:
Commitment to an aim meets the urge to be free of it.

Having signed up, the Part of Spirit means to stay. Uranus opposite wants to keep its options open. One of you is always nearly leaving the project and the other is always holding it together. Threats to quit are common and seldom carried out. It works when the committed partner allows real escape hatches and the restless one stops rattling them for sport.
composite_aspect.spirit_sextile_uranus:
A fresh approach would free an aim that has got stuck.

Uranus in sextile to the Part of Spirit suggests doing it another way entirely. Drop the method everyone uses. Ask the person least like you. Try the thing for a fortnight as an experiment with no commitment. You need to opt in. The pair that does usually finds the obstacle was the approach and never the goal.
composite_aspect.spirit_square_uranus:
You keep abandoning what you set out to do.

Three weeks in, one of you is bored. Uranus square the Part of Spirit breaks intentions before they bear fruit, sometimes for a better idea and sometimes just for air. The steadier partner feels the ground go each time. The restless one feels buried alive. A cupboard of nearly finished projects is the visible record of this aspect.
composite_aspect.spirit_trine_uranus:
You change course gracefully when a plan stops making sense.

Other couples cling. With Uranus trine the Part of Spirit the pair can see, without drama, that the aim needs revising, and can turn quickly to something that fits better. Inventiveness serves purpose. You are good in a crisis and good with new tools. Slow, traditional routes bore you, even on the rare occasions when they are the right ones.
composite_aspect.spirit_conjunction_venus:
What you set out to do is mostly about love and pleasing things.

The couple's intention is a happy one. With Venus on the Part of Spirit you aim deliberately at a lovely home, good company and each other's delight, and you are skilled at all three. It is not a small purpose. The limit is that anything unpleasant but necessary, a hard talk, a dull form, gets left for a tomorrow that keeps moving.
composite_aspect.spirit_opposition_venus:
One of you has the purpose and the other has the charm.

The Part of Spirit decides what should happen. Venus across the way makes people willing to let it. That is a useful division until the purposeful partner starts treating the charming one as staff, or the charmer feels the plan is all that matters. Then affection is withheld and the plan mysteriously stalls. Notice the connection.
composite_aspect.spirit_sextile_venus:
Your aims would go further with a little charm applied.

Venus in sextile to the Part of Spirit reminds the pair that people help those they like. Feed the volunteers. Thank the clerk. Make the proposal look good on the page. None of it is the point and all of it eases the way. Couples who think it beneath them do the same work against a headwind.
composite_aspect.spirit_square_venus:
What you want to achieve and what you would enjoy keep pulling apart.

The evening class clashes with the dinner. Saving for the deposit means no trip this year. Venus square the Part of Spirit sets pleasure against purpose in a long series of small choices, and whichever wins, somebody sulks. You are not short of love. You are short of evenings, and you spend a surprising number of them negotiating.
composite_aspect.spirit_trine_venus:
You go after what you want pleasantly, and it works.

Nobody is bullied in this house. With Venus trine the Part of Spirit the couple pursues its aims by agreement and good humor, and tends to attract kind collaborators. Work and affection do not compete. If there is a fault, it is a reluctance to press when pressing is needed, since things have usually come right without it.
composite_aspect.pholus_conjunction_ascendant:
Small things said in passing change how the world sees this couple.

You walk in, somebody makes a remark, and by the end of the evening a plan has been overturned. With Pholus on the Ascendant the pair sets things off simply by being present: a throwaway comment starts a feud or a friendship, a first meeting becomes a turning point. People remember you. They also learn to be a little careful what they open in your company.
composite_aspect.pholus_opposition_ascendant:
Other people keep taking the lid off things in your life.

A partner's friend lets slip a secret. A client makes one casual request. Pholus opposite the Ascendant sits where others stand, so the small act that changes everything is usually somebody else's. One of you welcomes the shake up. The other would like to be consulted first. You cannot stop it, only agree on how to meet it.
composite_aspect.pholus_sextile_ascendant:
A slight change in how you present yourselves could have surprising effects.

The Ascendant in sextile to Pholus means a minor adjustment carries a long way: a different greeting, a new name on the bell, turning up to the thing you usually skip. It has to be tried deliberately. Most of what follows is pleasant, and out of proportion to the effort. Pairs who never vary the routine do not find out.
composite_aspect.pholus_square_ascendant:
Trivial slips in company keep growing into real trouble.

A joke lands wrong at a wedding. An email is copied to the wrong person. The Ascendant square Pholus turns a small social misstep into weeks of fallout, and it happens to the two of you oftener than seems fair. One wants to apologize at once and the other says leave it alone. Left alone, these things have a way of getting bigger.
composite_aspect.pholus_trine_ascendant:
Chance encounters tend to open doors for you.

You sat next to the right stranger. With the Ascendant trine Pholus, little moments at the edge of your life, a nod, a favor, a seat on a train, have a habit of turning into something, and usually something welcome. It makes the pair relaxed with new people. You could be more deliberate about it, but luck has made you lazy.
composite_aspect.pholus_conjunction_chiron:
One touch on the sore spot and everything comes out.

There is an old hurt in this relationship, and a hair trigger beside it. Chiron joined to Pholus means a small reminder, a song, a tone of voice, a date on the calendar, releases far more than the moment warrants. It can be frightening. It is also how the hurt finally gets aired. Afterwards the house is quiet and somehow lighter.
composite_aspect.pholus_opposition_chiron:
One of you opens the subject and the other is the one who bleeds.

A light question at breakfast, and the partner across the table has gone white. Pholus on one side uncorks, and Chiron on the other holds what was in the bottle. Then you argue about whether it should have been mentioned at all. It probably should. The asking could be kinder, and the timing could avoid Monday mornings.
composite_aspect.pholus_sextile_chiron:
A small, well chosen gesture could begin a great deal of mending.

Chiron in sextile to Pholus puts a modest key in a heavy lock. One letter to an estranged brother. One appointment finally booked. The two of you know which. Turn it on purpose and relief spreads through parts of life you had not connected. Leave it and nothing gets worse, which is the best excuse there is for never doing it.
composite_aspect.pholus_square_chiron:
Minor slights keep setting off major pain.

Somebody forgets to say thank you and an hour later you are discussing a childhood. Chiron square Pholus links a light touch to a deep bruise, so the pair is ambushed by its own reactions. The one who made the careless remark feels the response is absurd. The one who is hurting cannot stop. It repeats until you both learn the short list of triggers by heart.
composite_aspect.pholus_trine_chiron:
Old troubles come to the surface gently and at a good moment.

Something loosens over a second glass of wine and is talked through by midnight. With Chiron trine Pholus the pair has a knack for letting painful things out in small, manageable amounts, so nothing festers and nothing explodes. Friends confide in you for the same reason. It is a quiet talent and you barely know you have it.
composite_aspect.pholus_conjunction_jupiter:
Small beginnings grow enormous in this couple's hands.

A hobby turns into a company. A weekend away turns into emigration. Jupiter with Pholus enlarges whatever gets started, quickly and past all planning, and the pair has several stories that begin we only meant to. Much of it is wonderful. The same law applies to a debt, an argument or a habit, so mind what you plant.
composite_aspect.pholus_opposition_jupiter:
One partner lifts a lid and the other makes a festival of what comes out.

A passing idea from one of you, we could always sell up, and the other has drawn floor plans by supper. With Jupiter opposite Pholus a spark on one side meets fuel on the other. It is exciting and it runs away with you. Somebody has to say, each time, that it was only a thought. It is rarely the same somebody twice.
composite_aspect.pholus_sextile_jupiter:
A modest first step could lead somewhere very large.

Jupiter in sextile to Pholus rewards the pair that dares to begin small. Send one enquiry. Take the introductory class. Put a hundred into the idea. The growth afterwards is not your doing, but the start has to be. Couples who wait until they can do it properly on a grand scale are still waiting.
composite_aspect.pholus_square_jupiter:
Things you start keep getting out of proportion.

You said yes to one committee. Jupiter square Pholus takes a small commitment and inflates it until it fills the diary, the spare room and most conversations. Neither of you can say when it stopped being optional. One enjoys the scale and the other wants the old life back. You have this out every time a new one starts to swell.
composite_aspect.pholus_trine_jupiter:
A little goes a long way, and usually in the right direction.

One kind word gets you an upgrade. With Jupiter trine Pholus the pair lives among happy overreactions: small efforts answered generously, minor bets that pay. It encourages you to try things, which is all to the good. Remember that you did not earn all of it, and be open handed with people whose small efforts get no such answer.
composite_aspect.pholus_conjunction_mars:
A flash of temper is all it takes to change everything.

One sharp word and the job is gone, the door is slammed, the car is sold. Mars on Pholus gives the pair an explosive quality: tiny provocations, immediate and total responses. Sometimes that is courage, and a stuck situation is cleared in a minute. Sometimes it is a fortnight of repairs. You have learned to count to something before replying.
composite_aspect.pholus_opposition_mars:
One of you lights the match and the other is the powder.

It takes very little. Pholus on one side offers a small provocation, sometimes without meaning to. Mars on the other responds at full strength. Afterwards the first says I hardly said anything, which is true, and the second says you knew what would happen, which is also true. Learn each other's short fuses and stop testing them for interest.
composite_aspect.pholus_sextile_mars:
One decisive act could break a long deadlock.

Mars in sextile to Pholus says the thing is ready to move and needs a single firm shove. Make the complaint. Clear the shed. Tell the lodger. You must pick the moment yourselves, which is the advantage, since a chosen shove goes where you aim it. Hold back and the pressure finds its own way out later, less tidily.
composite_aspect.pholus_square_mars:
Little irritations keep blowing up into fights.

A cupboard door left open. The wrong tone on the phone. Mars square Pholus has the two of you going from nothing to shouting in under a minute, and both are startled every time. The subject is never worth it. What gets said in the heat is harder to take back than the cupboard door was to shut.
composite_aspect.pholus_trine_mars:
When action is needed, a small push gets a big result.

You shove once and the whole thing shifts. With Mars trine Pholus the pair has an economical sort of force, one phone call and a year of muddle is cleared up, and a good instinct for where to apply it. Crises do not rattle you. You are less patient with slow processes that cannot be hurried by any amount of pushing.
composite_aspect.pholus_conjunction_mercury:
A single sentence can redirect your whole life together.

Something is said, half as a joke, and cannot be unsaid. Mercury joined to Pholus gives words unusual consequences in this house: a text read by the wrong person, a question that opens a subject closed for years. Conversation here is never idle. Think before sending, and keep a few things for saying in person.
composite_aspect.pholus_opposition_mercury:
One of you says the small thing and the other cannot leave it alone.

A remark is dropped. Then Mercury opposite picks it up, turns it over and asks eleven questions, until the molehill has a summit and a flag. Or it is the talker who opens the subject and the other who will not stop feeling it. Either way a minor comment takes the evening. Agree a signal that means I was only thinking aloud.
composite_aspect.pholus_sextile_mercury:
The right few words, said on purpose, would release a great deal.

Mercury in sextile to Pholus points at a conversation the two of you have been walking round. It need not be long. One honest sentence to a parent, a boss or each other, and a whole set of arrangements can rearrange for the better. You have to choose to say it. Unsaid, it leaks out sideways as sarcasm.
composite_aspect.pholus_square_mercury:
Careless remarks keep starting things you cannot stop.

You did not mean it like that. Mercury square Pholus turns slips of the tongue into incidents: the wrong name, the forwarded message, the opinion repeated to its subject. The pair spends a wearying amount of time explaining. One of you talks too freely and the other reads too much in. Between you, small words do large damage.
composite_aspect.pholus_trine_mercury:
A casual word in the right ear tends to work wonders.

You mention it once and it is sorted. With Mercury trine Pholus the pair has light, effective speech: the well timed question, the note that gets the refund, the introduction that changes a friend's career. News travels kindly from your house. Use it for others as readily as you use it for yourselves.
composite_aspect.pholus_conjunction_mc:
One small public act can make or unmake your reputation.

A letter to the paper. A minute of video. With Pholus on the Midheaven the couple's standing turns on something slight and visible, and the effect lasts for years. You may become known for a thing you did in an afternoon. That can be the making of a career. Check what goes out under your names, twice.
composite_aspect.pholus_opposition_mc:
Something small at home keeps overturning your public plans.

The job is going well. Then a child's remark, a parent's fall, a leak under the bath. Pholus opposite the Midheaven sits at the root of the chart, so the uncorking happens in private and the career has to bend round it. The ambitious partner calls it bad luck. The other suspects the house is trying to tell you something.
composite_aspect.pholus_sextile_mc:
A modest move at work could have an outsized effect on your standing.

The Midheaven in sextile to Pholus suggests one small professional step, an offer to help, a question asked upward, a sample sent, placed where it will spread. You do not need a campaign. You do need to do the one thing, deliberately, instead of hoping to be noticed. The result usually surprises the pair that tries it.
composite_aspect.pholus_square_mc:
Small troubles at home keep spilling into your public life, and the reverse.

A row before work becomes a botched meeting. A comment from the boss becomes a week of bad temper in the kitchen. Pholus square the Midheaven leaves the pair with no bulkhead between career and everything else, so minor upsets run the length of the ship. Who brought it home tonight is a nightly question in bad months.
composite_aspect.pholus_trine_mc:
Little efforts at work tend to be noticed and rewarded.

You did somebody a small favor and it came back as a promotion. With Pholus trine the Midheaven the pair's public life benefits from tiny causes: a good first day, one extra courtesy, a name remembered. Advancement feels almost accidental. Give credit where it is due, because a fair amount of it is due to people who put in a word.
composite_aspect.pholus_conjunction_moon:
A small change in mood can turn the whole household over.

One of you wakes up low and by evening a decision has been made about moving. The Moon with Pholus ties feelings to chain reactions, so tears lead to truths and truths to rearranged lives. It is not comfortable. It does mean nothing stays bottled here for long. Eat something before the big conversations.
composite_aspect.pholus_opposition_moon:
One of you lets something slip and the other feels all of it.

A casual announcement at dinner. Across the table, the Moon takes it in the stomach. With Pholus opposite the Moon, a light act on one side releases a flood on the other, and the first is always surprised. I did not think you would mind. You do well to give warning: there is something small I want to mention, and it may not be small to you.
composite_aspect.pholus_sextile_moon:
Tending one small need could settle a great deal else.

The Moon in sextile to Pholus says that some minor comfort is carrying more weight than you think. A nap. A locked door for half an hour. Seeing your sister monthly. Arrange it on purpose and moods across the whole house improve. You would never guess the size of the effect from the size of the cause.
composite_aspect.pholus_square_moon:
Tiny upsets keep turning into household storms.

The wrong milk, and somebody is crying about their mother. The Moon square Pholus connects small domestic frictions to large stored feeling, and the cork is always loose. The calmer partner tries to solve the milk. The other needed something else entirely. It is tiring to live in, and it passes faster when no one argues about proportion.
composite_aspect.pholus_trine_moon:
Feelings come out easily here, before they have time to build.

A sigh is noticed and asked about. With the Moon trine Pholus the pair lets emotion off in small releases, so there are few scenes and no long sulks. Children and animals do well in such a house. You might be slow to recognize real trouble, having so little practice at things going unsaid.
composite_aspect.pholus_conjunction_neptune:
A small indulgence or a passing dream can carry you both away.

One glass, one film, one evening at somebody's retreat, and the pair is off. Neptune with Pholus dissolves limits quickly, sometimes into art or faith that changes your lives and sometimes into a habit that takes them over. From inside, the two feel alike. A plain spoken friend who knew you before is worth keeping close.
composite_aspect.pholus_opposition_neptune:
One of you opens a bottle and the other disappears into it.

A suggestion is floated. The partner across the chart takes it up with total, unquestioning faith, or else dissolves into worry about it. Pholus opposite Neptune gives a small release on one side and no edges at all on the other. The first is alarmed by what the second makes of things. Say clearly which ideas are only ideas.
composite_aspect.pholus_sextile_neptune:
Letting a little imagination in could change more than you expect.

Neptune in sextile to Pholus invites one small opening to something less practical: music on in the mornings, a sketchbook, ten quiet minutes. You have to allow it. The effect on a dry, overscheduled household is large and gentle. Couples who dismiss it as not really them go on being efficient and faintly parched.
composite_aspect.pholus_square_neptune:
Small evasions keep spreading into general confusion.

A white lie about a price. A bill put in a drawer. Neptune square Pholus lets a little fog out and soon nobody can see across the room: who knew what, what was agreed, where the money went. One of you starts it and the other adds to it by not asking. Clearing up takes ten times what honesty would have cost.
composite_aspect.pholus_trine_neptune:
A hint of magic gets into ordinary days without anyone arranging it.

Somebody hums and the whole evening changes key. With Neptune trine Pholus the pair is easily and pleasantly transported: by a view, a piece of music, a kindness from a stranger. It costs nothing and does you good. Practical matters still need a date and a signature, and you sometimes drift past both.
composite_aspect.pholus_conjunction_north_node:
The turning points in your life together come from very small things.

You missed a train. That is how most of the important chapters began. With Pholus on the North Node the couple grows by accident, a trivial event uncorks the next stage, and you are thrown forward whether ready or not. It has served you well. Trust it a little, and keep a bag packed in the figurative sense.
composite_aspect.pholus_opposition_north_node:
The lid keeps coming off the past just as you try to move on.

Opposite the North Node, Pholus stands with the South Node, so what gets uncorked is old: a former partner writes, a family story resurfaces, a habit you thought dead walks back in. Growth has to wait while it is dealt with. One of you is drawn to it and the other wants the door shut. Deal with it once, properly.
composite_aspect.pholus_sextile_north_node:
One small yes could open the next stage of your life.

The North Node in sextile to Pholus places a modest invitation in front of the pair: a favor asked, a vacancy mentioned, a course with one place left. It looks like nothing. Accept deliberately and a good deal follows. This aspect does not push, so couples who prefer to be pushed let the moment go by and never learn its size.
composite_aspect.pholus_square_north_node:
Small upsets keep knocking you off the path you meant to follow.

You were finally getting somewhere. Then a minor crisis, a row, a broken boiler, somebody else's emergency. Pholus square the North Node spends the pair's forward motion on spillages. One of you says these things happen. The other suspects you both half welcome the interruption. That is worth an honest conversation, on a calm day.
composite_aspect.pholus_trine_north_node:
Accidents tend to move you in the right direction.

The wrong turning led to the right town. With Pholus trine the North Node, chance events in the couple's life have a way of serving its growth, and you look back on several disasters with gratitude. It breeds a useful calm. Do not lean on it so hard that you stop steering altogether.
composite_aspect.pholus_conjunction_pluto:
Small cracks let out something very deep.

A minor disagreement about money, and you are suddenly at the foundations: trust, power, what each of you would do to survive. Pluto on Pholus means there is no shallow end. That intensity can remake the pair for the better. It can also flatten a Tuesday evening over nothing, and you have both learned to dread a certain quiet.
composite_aspect.pholus_opposition_pluto:
One of you lets a small thing out and the other treats it as war.

A minor admission. Across the chart, Pluto hears a betrayal and brings up everything. With Pholus opposite Pluto, lightness on one side meets total seriousness on the other, so nothing can be mentioned casually. The first learns to hide trifles, which makes it worse. Better to agree that small things may be said without a trial.
composite_aspect.pholus_sextile_pluto:
Opening one difficult subject could clear the ground for years.

Pluto in sextile to Pholus says something buried is ready to come up, and a small opening would be enough. Ask the question about the will. Show the bank statement. Choose a calm afternoon for it. What follows is strong medicine and it works. Couples who decline keep the peace and a locked room in the middle of the house.
composite_aspect.pholus_square_pluto:
Trivial things keep triggering struggles for control.

Who moved the keys. Who read whose message. Pluto square Pholus turns a small event into a test of power, with all the old suspicions let out at once. Neither of you intends it. Both of you escalate. The damage is done less by the original matter than by what is dug up to win the argument about it.
composite_aspect.pholus_trine_pluto:
When something breaks open, you come through it stronger.

A secret surfaces and the pair deals with it in a weekend. With Pluto trine Pholus you have unusual capacity for the big release: the confession, the bankruptcy, the death in the family. You do not look away and you do not fall apart. Lighter moments are harder for you, and friends sometimes wish you would just gossip.
composite_aspect.pholus_conjunction_saturn:
The thing you kept the lid on for years finally gives.

Saturn holds, and holds, and then Pholus is the day it stops. In this couple, long restraint ends suddenly: the resignation after twenty years, the diet abandoned in one evening, the truth told at a funeral. It feels like collapse and is often the start of something more honest. Let a little out regularly and the break is gentler.
composite_aspect.pholus_opposition_saturn:
One of you keeps the lid on and the other keeps lifting it.

Saturn's partner says not now, not here, not in front of the children. Pholus opposite cannot see why not and says it anyway. So one feels exposed and the other feels gagged. Each is partly right about timing. You could settle most of it by agreeing where and when things may be opened, and then honoring that.
composite_aspect.pholus_sextile_saturn:
A small, steady release of pressure would prevent a large one.

Saturn in sextile to Pholus offers the sensible course: open the valve a quarter turn on purpose. One evening off a week. One complaint voiced when it is still minor. Dutiful pairs resist this as self indulgence. It is maintenance, and the two of you are otherwise very good at maintenance.
composite_aspect.pholus_square_saturn:
Rules and restraint keep being blown apart by small lapses.

A strict budget, and then one mad Saturday. Months of politeness, and then one sentence. Saturn square Pholus sets a tight lid on a lively bottle, and the pair swings between control and spillage. The careful partner blames the lapse. The other blames the lid. Loosen the rule slightly and it might survive.
composite_aspect.pholus_trine_saturn:
You know how to let things out in an orderly way.

Grievances are raised at the monthly review and dealt with. With Saturn trine Pholus the couple has safety valves that work: a realistic budget with a treats line, a rule that anything can be said on a walk. Nothing builds to a bang. It is not exciting, and your household is the one others borrow calm from.
composite_aspect.pholus_conjunction_sun:
One small event can change who you are as a couple.

You were a pair of teachers and then, after one phone call, you were innkeepers. With the Sun on Pholus the couple's identity turns on slight causes, and it has probably been remade more than once. You carry it off with style. People who knew you before sometimes need a moment to catch up, and so do you.
composite_aspect.pholus_opposition_sun:
One partner's small act keeps upstaging the other's big plans.

The Sun on one side has a purpose, announced and under way. Pholus on the other does something minor, invites a guest, mentions a doubt, and the purpose is derailed. It is seldom deliberate. It happens often enough to look like a comment. Ask, without heat, whether the one with the corkscrew actually wants the plan to succeed.
composite_aspect.pholus_sextile_sun:
A minor change of habit could give you both new confidence.

The Sun in sextile to Pholus suggests trying one small thing that is slightly unlike you. Speak first at the meeting. Wear the color. Host instead of attending. It needs deciding, and the first time feels silly. Vitality comes back in proportion to very little effort, and others notice before you do.
composite_aspect.pholus_square_sun:
Pride takes a small knock and the whole day is lost.

Somebody is corrected in front of friends. With the Sun square Pholus a slight to either partner's dignity releases a quite unreasonable amount of feeling, and the pair has abandoned parties, holidays and at least one job over it. You see it clearly in each other. The remedy is undignified: laugh sooner.
composite_aspect.pholus_trine_sun:
Small successes build your confidence quickly.

One good review and you are away. With the Sun trine Pholus the pair is easily encouraged, and a little recognition releases a lot of energy and good work. It makes you productive and pleasant to praise. Learn to supply the spark yourselves, for the stretches when nobody else is handing out matches.
composite_aspect.pholus_conjunction_uranus:
Nothing stays as it is for long, and it takes almost nothing to change it.

A notification on a phone and you are moving cities. Uranus with Pholus doubles the suddenness: slight causes, instant upheavals, no going back. Life with this pair is vivid and hard to plan. You have a gift for landing upright. Give the people who rely on you slightly more notice than you get yourselves.
composite_aspect.pholus_opposition_uranus:
One of you sets something off and the other bolts.

A small development, a new lodger, a job offer, a pregnancy test. Pholus on one side opens it. Uranus on the other reacts by needing air, immediately. The opener feels abandoned at the worst moment. The bolter feels cornered. It goes better when the news comes with time to think, and the thinking has a deadline.
composite_aspect.pholus_sextile_uranus:
One small experiment could free you from a routine you have outgrown.

Uranus in sextile to Pholus says the arrangement is looser than it looks, and a nudge would shift it. Change one fixed day. Rearrange a single room. Take the other route to work. You have to try it on purpose. The pair that does is often surprised how much was held in place by one unexamined habit.
composite_aspect.pholus_square_uranus:
Sudden disruptions keep arriving out of nowhere.

A dropped phone, a cancelled flight, a whim. Uranus square Pholus makes the pair accident prone in the broad sense: small shocks, big reroutings, and never when convenient. One of you thrives on it and stirs it. The other is worn out and wants a month in which nothing happens. That month has to be planned and defended like any other project.
composite_aspect.pholus_trine_uranus:
Surprises suit you, and most of them turn out well.

The plan falls through and the replacement is better. With Uranus trine Pholus the pair adapts in seconds and often gains by it, so change holds no terror. Friends ring you when their own lives are upended. Stability is the thing you have to arrange on purpose, since it does not occur to either of you unprompted.
composite_aspect.pholus_conjunction_venus:
A small attraction or pleasure can sweep you both off your feet.

One look across a room is how this began, and it is how most things begin for the pair. Venus on Pholus makes affection and appetite quick to overflow: a taste becomes a collection, a flirtation becomes a crisis, a gift becomes a tradition. It is a warm, excessive household. Know which of your pleasures have a brake fitted.
composite_aspect.pholus_opposition_venus:
One of you does something slight and the other falls for it completely.

A compliment tossed out in passing. Venus on the far side takes it to heart and builds on it for weeks. Or a small coolness, and the other is sure love has ended. With Pholus opposite Venus the two of you do not weigh things on the same scales. Check what was meant before deciding what it means.
composite_aspect.pholus_sextile_venus:
A small romantic gesture would do far more than you imagine.

Venus in sextile to Pholus rewards the note on the pillow, the unplanned kiss in the kitchen, the favorite thing bought for no reason. These cost nothing and must be chosen. Affection spreads from one such act through a whole dull week. The pair that stops bothering does not quarrel. It simply cools, a degree at a time.
composite_aspect.pholus_square_venus:
Minor jealousies and small extravagances keep getting out of hand.

A friendly waiter, and the evening is ruined. A treat, and the card is at its limit. Venus square Pholus lets a little desire or a little doubt run on unchecked, and the pair pays for it in scenes and in interest. Each believes the other started it. Catch it at the first twinge and say so plainly.
composite_aspect.pholus_trine_venus:
Affection flows at the slightest prompting.

A hand on a shoulder and the mood is mended. With Venus trine Pholus the pair is easily pleased and easily reconciled, and small kindnesses go a long way in this house. Guests feel it. You are generous by reflex. The only caution is an occasional generosity with money that would be better as generosity with time.

This profound contact merges Vesta—governing the sacred focus, single-minded spiritual devotion, and inner light—directly with Venus, which acts as the relational harmony, shared affection, and aesthetic adhesive. Under this configuration, the partnership's capacity to stokes the inner calling, purifies creative ambitions, and maintains a sanctuary of deep, unwavering commitment is structurally linked with the urge to draws the partners together through mutual appreciation, romantic charm, and pleasure. The primary shadow of this composite contact manifests when one partner will naturally embody the minor point while the other acts out the classical planet; they must integrate both drives internally to achieve true relational balance. They must learn to consciously navigate where cold emotional withdrawal, denying bodily pleasure out of sterile guilt, or fanatical devotion that excludes others directly collides with codependent peace-keeping, superficial harmony, or financial self-indulgence. By intentionally keeping their shared spiritual fire burning, dedicating their daily focus to high art, and honoring sacred boundaries, they can successfully transform this alignment into a permanent source of mutual strength and evolutionary healing.
